pr_title: drivers: timer: nrf_rtc_timer: Add clearing of previous CC event
pr_body:
Added clearing of CC event which may occure due to previous
CC value which was closed to current counter value.

Fixes #30526.

Signed-off-by: Krzysztof Chruscinski <krzysztof.chruscinski@nordicsemi.no>
pr_comments:
See https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/29810#discussion_r532412748

Apparently, event though event is disabled it can still be generated (for previous CC value) and needs to be cleared.
I've moved event enabling before even though it seems to not be needed but according to RTC spec event generation depends on event being enabled. Spec: https://infocenter.nordicsemi.com/topic/ps_nrf52840/rtc.html?cp=4_0_0_5_21_5#concept_eml_dkj_sr

I've added additional test for resetting CC which happens just before earlier setting. It has shown that if event occurred when event was disabled in `EVTEN` it will expire immediately after enabling this event because of that first event is enabled then cleared (if previous event occurred).
Moreover, I've noticed that bsim behaves differently and busy wait in case of close event must be longer: full tick instead of half tick.
It seems that bsim is still not working #30507 on master and after this fix, too.

I've found an issue in nrf52_bsim model. Compare interrupts in RTC were lost if they occurred while interrupt was disabled. I've added PR (https://github.com/BabbleSim/ext_NRF52_hw_models/pull/17) that checks on INTENSET if there are pending interrupt and triggers it.

> Apparently, event though event is disabled it can still be generated (for previous CC value) and needs to be cleared.
I've moved event enabling before even though it seems to not be needed but according to RTC spec event generation depends on event being enabled.

Further testing shown that RTC behaves as in spec. If event is enabled but interrupt is disabled then event will set EVENTS_COMPARE[n]=1 and when interrupt is enabled that will generate nvic interrupt.
It also means that if event and interrupt is disabled then when compare event occurs it is not recorded at all.

Removing `DNM` as `nrf_hw_models` fix is in master. Updated revision in west.yml.

@nordic-krch seems that the cause of the assert is disabling CONFIG_TICKLESS_KERNEL by the test

I've added it to `prj.conf` now since that makes no harm for hw platforms and makes test work for bsim out of the box.
